area_fields.title: Area Fields
area_fields.description: Attributes of ``by_layer`` kept in the result.

Aggregate.title: Aggregate
Aggregate.description:
Summarise source features per feature of an area layer (F-4.7).

Every area feature appears in the result, with ``count`` 0 and other
metrics null where no source feature relates to it.

AttributeJoin.title: AttributeJoin
AttributeJoin.description:
Left join of a layer by key (F-4.6).

Joined fields are addressable by their name, or by ``prefix + name`` when a
prefix is given; clashes with source attributes are rejected.

bbox.title: Bbox
bbox.description: Two opposite corners [lon, lat, lon, lat] in WGS84; stored as [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat].

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: Source geometry intersects a WGS84 bounding box, e.g. the map view (F-4.3).

Between.title: Between
Between.description: Inclusive value range (F-4.2). The bounds may come in either order.

Buffer.title: Buffer
Buffer.description: Replace each source geometry by its buffer (F-4.5).

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Optional fixed colour per category value.

CountMetric.title: CountMetric
CountMetric.description: Number of source features per area.

DistanceRelation-Input.description: Source within ``distance_m`` of a feature of ``layer``.

DistanceRelation-Output.title: DistanceRelation
DistanceRelation-Output.description: Source within ``distance_m`` of a feature of ``layer``.

GeoJSONGeometry.title: GeoJSONGeometry
GeoJSONGeometry.description: GeoJSON geometry in WGS84. Coordinates are checked when compiled.

GeometryFilter.title: GeometryFilter
GeometryFilter.description: Source geometry relates to a drawn geometry (F-4.3).

ImportDecisions.title: ImportDecisions
ImportDecisions.description: What the wizard settled (design D6); everything not given follows the preview.

IsNull.title: IsNull
IsNull.description: Attribute has no value. Combine with ``not`` for 'has a value'.

What the model learns about a layer: structure and meaning, never content (F-9.3).

Derived from the metadata (F-2.8); only layers and attributes marked
``for_model``. E2.2 limits it to the layers visible to the user.

LayerUpdate.description: Curated layer fields. ``name`` never changes; renaming sets ``title`` (plan D1).

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A finding about the source; ``code`` is stable, ``message`` explains it.

NearFeature.title: NearFeature
NearFeature.description: Source geometry lies within a distance of one reference feature (F-4.3).

Op.title: Op
Op.description: Registered operations; each needs certain logical dialect functions (F-2.14).

QueryObject-Input.description: Declarative, backend-neutral description of one analysis.

QueryObject-Output.description: Declarative, backend-neutral description of one analysis.

QueryResult.description: A GeoJSON FeatureCollection plus the query and its provenance.
